METIS
Apache License, Version 2.0

Statically linked into the engine library that this mod carries. METIS supplies the
fill-reducing ordering the sparse factorisation depends on. Not used by the sidecar
executable of the earlier shipping shape.

Source: https://github.com/KarypisLab/METIS
